method: 3-state Gaussian HMM, tied variance (hand-rolled Baum-Welch) on daily % deviation from a rolling 2-year weather model (temperature, weekend, month); monthly expanding HMM refit; forward-filtered states ordered by mean (green < grey < red)
notes: Colors compare consumption with what the weather and the last two years' normal explain, not raw use.
Timeline and current state are forward-filtered: each day uses only data up to that day.
Data end 2023-12-31 (ISO-NE files for 2024+ were not available); 'current' is that day.
Load is all customer classes (homes + businesses) in each ISO-NE zone.
